# Environment variables the Go code reads (refactor plan S8, invariants I13
# and K8), found by a go/types scan of the module root and of every package
# under cmd/ and internal/, test files excluded. Written by TestEnvInventory
# (internal/archtest/env_inventory_test.go); regenerate with
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/archtest -count=1 -run '^TestEnvInventory$'
# (only UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 regenerates; any other value compares).
#
# One row per variable, read and default, sorted, tab-separated:
#   NAME     the variable
#   read     how it is read: os.Getenv or os.LookupEnv directly, or
#            <package>:<func>(<param>) through a getter, a function whose
#            string parameter reaches an env read or whose function-typed
#            parameter a call binds to os.Getenv; with a comparison after it,
#            such as =="true", when the value is only compared with that
#            string
#   default  the getter's fallback where the call passes a constant (text
#            quoted, a duration as time.Duration prints it), (computed) where
#            it passes anything else, - where the read has none
# testdata/env_parse.txt says what each read returns. Where each read sits
# (file:line, function, binaries) is in the report that
# go test -v -run '^TestEnvInventory$' ./internal/archtest logs.

# The exemptions: reads no constant names (unresolved, with ? for names;
# environ, the whole environment, *) and named reads that stay where they are
# when X10 moves configuration to internal/config (placement), K8's list.
# exemption	kind	names	reason
connector-agentd-environ	environ	*	agentd, which the connector starts, inherits the connector's environment plus WORKER_API_KEY, which goes through the environment rather than argv so that other processes cannot read it
mcp-tool-allowlist	placement	OPENV_MCP_TOOLS	a set but empty value means no tools, which only os.LookupEnv tells apart; openv-mcp applies it to its tool table
per-request	placement	OPENV_CLIENT_IP_HEADER,OPENV_MAX_EVIDENCE_MB,OPENV_MAX_UPLOAD_MB,OPENV_PUSH_ENDPOINT_HOSTS,OPENV_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS,OPENV_TRUST_PROXY,UPLOADS_DIR	read on every request (the client address, an upload or evidence size cap, a push endpoint, a report's attachment path), so a changed value applies without a restart
runner-child-environ	environ	*	every process the runner starts (a provider CLI's run, sign-in or version probe, and git) inherits the runner's environment, less the runner's own WORKER_API_KEY and RUNNER_POOL_KEY, with a run's variables layered on top, which is how a provider CLI finds its own settings
runner-gemini-auth-probe	placement	CLOUD_SHELL,GEMINI_API_KEY,GEMINI_CLI_USE_COMPUTE_ADC,GOOGLE_API_KEY,GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL,GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA,GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI	per run: before adding GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA, the runner checks each Gemini auth-mode variable the run's own environment leaves unset in the process environment the CLI will inherit
runner-probe	placement	ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,CODEX_HOME,GEMINI_API_KEY,GOOGLE_API_KEY,OPENAI_API_KEY	a provider's detection probes, run at registration and on each lease, see the environment the provider CLI will see, HOME included, which a pool lease changes
runner-provider-api-key	unresolved	?	per run: the claimed run's API-key variable, named by the API or the provider's default and limited by providers.IsAllowedAPIKeyEnv to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY
